tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to store and retrieve problems for the library.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Create and configure the database schema for storing problem details.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile Page
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user profiles and their statistics.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data and statistics.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and display leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Tutorials UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Tutorials Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy and reliability.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Ensure user profiles display correct data and function as intended.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard
tasks.description: Verify the leaderboard displays accurate rankings and updates correctly.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Tutorials
tasks.description: Ensure hints and tutorials are displayed and managed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and future scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an intuitive UI for users to submit code with syntax highlighting and file upload options.
T4.notes: Include error handling for invalid submissions.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a backend system to compile, execute, and evaluate code submissions securely.
T5.notes: Use sandboxing techniques to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user stats, achievements, and activity history.
T6.notes: Incorporate a clean and visually appealing layout.

T7.implementation_approach: Implement backend APIs to manage user data, including profile updates and activity tracking.
T7.notes: Ensure secure authentication and data privacy.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users with sorting and filtering options.
T8.notes: Highlight user rankings and achievements effectively.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings in real-time.
T9.notes: Optimize for performance with frequent updates.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a UI to display hints and tutorials with a clean and accessible layout.
T10.notes: Allow users to toggle visibility of hints.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement backend APIs to manage hints and tutorials, including retrieval and updates.
T11.notes: Ensure content is dynamically served based on user progress.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library, including UI and backend integration.
T12.notes: Test for edge cases and usability issues.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy, security, and performance.
T13.notes: Simulate various scenarios, including malicious code submissions.

T14.implementation_approach: Verify the functionality of user profiles, including data accuracy and UI responsiveness.
T14.notes: Test with different user roles and activity levels.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard for correct ranking calculations and real-time updates.
T15.notes: Ensure sorting and filtering work as expected.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate the hints and tutorials system for proper content delivery and UI behavior.
T16.notes: Check for accessibility and user engagement.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud environment with proper CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools.
T17.notes: Ensure scalability, security, and minimal downtime during deployment.
